name: shinu-mods
description: Orange-accented Claude Code mods: usage band, turn timer, bookmarks, message token footer, Godot kit, Notion tasks and devlog.

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: A band above the prompt: 5h/weekly limits, context fill, prompt-cache countdown with reheat, threshold alerts and session tokens.

plugins.name: turn-timer
plugins.description: Status line timer for the running turn: elapsed time and tool calls, then last-turn and session totals.

plugins.name: bookmarks
plugins.description: Bookmark points in a session with /bookmark and browse them in a pane with /bookmarks.

plugins.name: message-cost
plugins.description: A dim footer under each assistant message: tokens in and out, how many came from the prompt cache, and cache writes.

plugins.name: godot-kit
plugins.description: Godot 4 helpers: a GDScript check after every .gd edit, a /play run panel Claude can read, and a /scene tree viewer that marks what Claude's edits changed.

plugins.name: notion-tasks
plugins.description: A /board pane of your Notion tasks (▶ hands one to Claude, ✓ marks it done) and /devlog, which posts a session devlog to Notion only on Post.
